tagline.en_US: A web application to manage and monitor 3D printers. The official Docker image and web interface can start without a printer attached; persist /octoprint and pass through USB or camera devices only when needed.

description.en_US: OctoPrint is a web-based interface designed to manage and monitor 3D printers. It provides tools to start, pause, and control printing jobs directly from a web browser. Users can also supervise printing progress with connected cameras and generate timelapses of their print jobs.
